text:
mira: idea  build a migration-simulator service that can run a dry-run of a target model vs current model on a tenant's live sample traffic and produce a Risk Score + Migration Plan. would help product and CSMs decide recs.
oscar: love this. simulator outputs: perf delta (p50/p95), token cost delta, embed similarity distribution, hallucination index, and user-visible quality delta on N golden prompts. put everything in a single report URL.
peter: runtime notes: do not change the public model_id in dry-run. instead route a mirrored copy of X% of requests to the simulator backend for replay, and store responses with a correlation id. add header X-Migration-DryRun.
quinn: CSM workflow: attach simulator report to a migration ticket template. auto-suggest 3 options: auto-migrate (with credits), schedule-assisted migration, or request exception review. include estimated downtime (should be zero) and rollback steps.
rachel: billing/legal: migration credits need an approval threshold. propose: credits autogenerated if risk_score < 0.2 and tenant size < medium. otherwise manual approval. store credit metadata on tenant record: migration_credit_amount and credit_reason.
mira: UX: in-console "Preview migration" button that triggers simulator for a sampled timeframe (last 24h or last 1k requests) and shows expected token delta and sample diff pairs. clickable items allow replaying specific examples.
oscar: metrics/thresholds: define risk tiers 0-0.2 (green), 0.2-0.5 (amber), >0.5 (red). green -> self-serve; amber -> CSM review; red -> block + manual remediation. risk formula = weighted sum of quality_delta(0.6), embed_shift(0.2), perf_regression(0.1), cost_delta(0.1).
peter: infra constraints: need a sandboxed replay cluster to avoid affecting production KV caches and rate limits. also quota tagging so we don't affect billing. simulator should run asynchronously and expire stored samples after 90 days.
quinn: comms: simulate -> draft email with clear CTAs: "Run full migration", "Request human review", "Decline". decide cadence: initial advisory + 30d follow-up if unaddressed.
rachel: implement feature flags: simulator_enabled, auto_credit_on_migration. we also need audit log entries for auto-migrates and credit grants. legal wants opt-in language for credits.
oscar: testing: run simulator across 50 tenants as a beta. collect edge cases (templated prompts, function calls, streaming sessions) and update golden prompt set.
mira: dataset/privacy: scrub PII before storing snapshots. use token hashing for inputs; store only normalized prompts and model outputs. add privacy toggle per-tenant.
peter: rollout plan: 1) API v1 /migration_simulate (sampled) 2) UI button + report page 3) auto-credit integration 4) full self-serve migration. gating: security review + privacy checklist + perf isolation tested.
deploy-bot: infra: branch migration-sim queued for staging; schema change: tenant_metadata.v3 -> adds migration_credit_amount and migration_risk_exempt flags.
quinn: owners: mira (product), oscar (metrics/eval), peter (runtime/infra), rachel (billing/legal), quinn (CS playbooks). aim for MVP in 6 sprint weeks.
mira: next step: oscar will draft risk formula and sample report mock; peter will prototype mirrored replay. sync Thursday 9am.
